recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球稀少，但出現的有核細胞多數是核質比高、細胞質少的母細胞，只見到少數嗜中性球與淋巴球，代表循環中母細胞比例高，符合由 MDS 進展而來的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Low-power field with few nucleated cells overall, suggestive of leukopenia
Most nucleated cells are blasts: medium-sized with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Only rare segmented neutrophils and lymphocytes
Platelets appear present but not abundant
Red cells largely normocytic; fine blast detail (nucleoli, Auer rods) not resolvable at this power
describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows relatively few nucleated cells, the majority of which are blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Only rare segmented neutrophils and lymphocytes are seen. Red cells are largely normocytic, and platelets are present in modest numbers. Nuclear detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In a patient with prior MDS with excess blasts, findings are consistent with progression to acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB-2 has 5–19% peripheral blasts, so a blast count of ≥20% (here 26%) is required to call AML.
Lymphoblasts may look similar at low power, and flow cytometry is needed for lineage assignment.
Separated by history of prior cytotoxic therapy rather than morphology.
